extracted.name: Sara’s Sweet and Sour Chicken
extracted.description: Sweet and sour chicken with pineapple, green peppers, celery, and water chestnuts in a soy, vinegar, and brown sugar sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 (20 ounce) can pineapple chunks, juice reserved
1 (8 ounce) can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1.5 pounds cooked chicken meat, cut into strips
instruction_lines: Blend reserved pineapple juice, soy sauce, vinegar, and brown sugar in a 12-inch skillet or large saucepan over medium-low heat; mix in flour, and stir until thickened.
Stir in bell peppers, celery, and water chestnuts. Mix in cooked chicken and stir until heated through. Stir in pineapple chunks before serving.
